title: Rust test gate: compile bundled SQLite optimized and set thread and fd defaults from measurement
outcome: Rust test gate: compile bundled SQLite optimized and set thread and fd defaults from measurement
acceptance: The Unix fd soft-limit target is raised as Greg instructed on 2026-09-26, and a host that refuses the target is left with a limit no lower than the previous target of 4096 would have given it
The bundled SQLite C library and sha2 are compiled with optimization in the dev/test profile through Cargo.toml profile overrides, and the full Rust gate passes on that build
The default test-thread count in scripts/test-rust.sh and scripts/test-rust.ps1 is chosen from wall-time measurements recorded in this item's notes
docs/development.md states the profile overrides, the new defaults, what was measured and what was not, and how to override them

completion.summary: Landed as 1789bad on origin/master (fast-forward from 3c61054) on Greg's word "commit", 2026-09-26. The dev profile builds sha2 and the bundled SQLite optimized; the Rust gate defaults to eight test threads, or the available processors on a host with fewer, or four where none is reported; the Unix fd soft-limit target is 16384 at Greg's instruction, with a step-down that never leaves a host below what 4096 gave it. Both host functions live in scripts/test-rust-host.sh and are tested against stubbed hosts in scripts/test-launcher.test.mjs; docs/development.md gives the defaults, the measurements and what was not measured. Full gate passed on the committed tree's fingerprint bdc038784b9dac7a474e459bdc5551ee8d487ea993e90147bec7efd59eace403 (run test-c9712474, 652s) and both reviewers returned no findings on it in round 7; every finding of rounds 1 to 5 was fixed and reviewed again. Independent acceptance evaluation recorded 17:29:37 local, all four criteria passed (Codex session-7896). Not installed: the release binary is built from unchanged source. Left for other items: the root-delta scale phase, 64% of the gate; how the bundled SQLite is compiled.
